title: Weatherford Completes Redomestication to the United States
body_markdown:
HOUSTON, Nov. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Weatherford International Corp (NASDAQ: WFRD) (“Weatherford” or the “Company”) today announced that it has completed its previously announced redomestication from Ireland to Delaware. As a result of the redomestication, the Company expects to generate approximately $20 million to $30 million in annual cash savings beginning in 2027.


The redomestication was completed through a scheme of arrangement under Irish law. As a result, Weatherford International Corp, a Delaware corporation, has become the publicly traded parent company of the Weatherford group.


Each outstanding ordinary share of Weatherford International plc was cancelled in exchange for a share of common stock of Weatherford International Corp on a one-for-one basis. Weatherford’s common stock will continue to trade on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol “WFRD.”


The redomestication does not change Weatherford’s business operations, management, strategy or headquarters. The Company’s directors and executive officers will continue in their respective roles with Weatherford International Corp.


Girish Saligram, Weatherford’s President and Chief Executive Officer, commented, “The completion of our redomestication represents another deliberate step in positioning Weatherford for long-term success. We have built a stronger, more focused and more resilient Company, and this move further simplifies our structure as we continue to execute our strategy. Our focus remains on delivering differentiated value for our customers, maintaining disciplined capital allocation and driving sustainable shareholder returns.”


In connection with the redomestication, Weatherford’s Board of Directors adopted and assumed the Company’s existing capital return program, including the remaining authorization under its share repurchase program through June 2027 and the intent to continue paying regular quarterly cash dividends. The timing and amount of any share repurchases and future dividends will remain subject to applicable legal requirements, market and business conditions and the discretion of the Board of Directors.


Additional information regarding the redomestication is available in Weatherford’s filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.


**About Weatherford**


Weatherford is a global energy services company that helps customers drill smarter, complete wells more effectively, and maximize production across the entire well lifecycle. With a differentiated portfolio of market-leading solutions, integrated technologies, and a broad global customer footprint across six continents, we blend advanced engineering, digital intelligence, and world-class field expertise to reduce risk, improve performance, and maximize the value of customer assets. Together, we elevate every operation, delivering stronger wells, sharper decisions, and better energy for the world. Visit weatherford.com for more information and connect with us on social media.
